Kural 1078 says the base yield use only when crushed (கொல்லப் பயன்படும் கீழ்); Pazhamozhi 100 says the punished go on doing evil (ஒறுத்தமை கண்டும் ... தீயவை பின்னரும் செய்தல்), cut a cubit and it grows a span. Item 2 பயனிலவும் is the Kural's பயனில் சொல், so the item carries the link. These are not incompatible claims about death: 39 does not make death light, and its stress on hard virtue agrees with 37's call to strive, so the tension is manufactured and teaches misdescribes 39.

links.reason: Elathi 7 joins இன்சொல் to இடம் and இனிதூண் in one welcome; Pazhamozhi 338 gives the case where clothing, medicine, shelter and food (உடுக்கை மருந்துறையுள் உண்டி) are given but the sweet word at parting is withheld (விடுத்தின்சொல் ஈயாமை), stingy over spice after killing a buffalo. It is the exact failure case of Elathi's list.

The overlap is real (கண் ஓடாது / கண்ணோட்டம் இன்றாம்; சிறிதுரைத்து / எள்ளுமாம்), but both are portraits of the base, a shared type. Pazhamozhi's closing question நரகர்கட்கு இல்லையோ நஞ்சு is a verdict, as list_adds says, yet 'description turning into a judgement' says little a reader would not see from either verse; the proverb's sense is also unsettled.

verses.note: Lines 1-2 plainly point to Mal who held off the rain for the cows and is called a cowherd; taken as a named figure, not an unnamed case.
Raising and entrusting men (ஆற்றப் பெருக்கி ... விட்டிருப்பின்) is read as a ruler's appointment; it could be any employer.
No count word, so items are not given; the rules on eating and removing the vessel are read as ritual and diet norms.
The count word ஈரைந்து gives ten places; the spittle and the two excretions of line 3 are what is not done there, not counted items.
Farming and hospitality (வேளாண்மை, விருந்தோம்பி) point to the householder, though line 1-2 also name valour in battle.
No number word, but என்றிவர்கட்டு gathers an explicit list of eight to whom one gives way, so the items are given; பார்ப்பார் and பெண்டிர் in the rule make it caste and gender.
An unnamed husband in other women's arms, addressed through the பாண், is a specific case rather than a type.
Conduct in the king's presence (இறைவனைச் சாரார் செவியோரார்), so the courtier's domain rather than ritual-conduct.
Four things not boasted of before kings, but no count word, so items are not given; குலமுடையார் names who keeps the rule and is not read as a birth rule.

pazhamozhi.who: உமையாள் ஒரு பாலக் கட்டங்கம் வெல்கொடி கொண்டான்

verses.note: The proverb comes first (lines 1-2) and names Siva by his marks.
